title: 05 ATG Mobility / Handover
description: HO / CHO / DAPS / RLF — A2G aerial mobility (TS 38.331). Lab F1 HO via CU telnet `ci trigger_f1_ho` (dual-DU Path-B/A2G) lights authentic counters when CU logs `handover for UE … complete!`.

panels.title: HO honesty notice
panels.description: Session topology note — not a KPI. Source: OAI CU/DU log scan + modeled A3.

options.content: **Provenance split.** Modeled A3 = `source=sionna` / `event_origin=model` / `procedure=modeled_a3`. Authentic OAI = `source=oai` / `event_origin=oai`. F1 CI demo (`ci trigger_f1_ho` on CU :9099) stays `mechanism=f1_ci_trigger` — **not** measurement-driven A3. Panels group HO rates by `source` so the series never mix. See `HO_AERIAL_LIVE.md` and `CAPABILITY_AUTHENTIC_HO.md`.

panels.title: Signaling rate by procedure
panels.description: sum by(procedure)(rate(atg_sig_msg_total[5m])) — parsed OAI/T-tracer/pcap (TS 38.331 / 38.413). Measured when tokens present (e.g. sib1).

panels.title: RRC setup / re-estab rates
panels.description: rate(atg_rrc_setup_*_total) + rate(atg_rrc_reestab_*_total) (TS 38.331). Parsed only — absent until authentic RRC Setup/Reestab lines exist.

panels.title: HO attempt / success / fail
panels.description: NO DATA — HO counters stay empty until authentic OAI HO tokens appear (e.g. `Handover triggered` / `handover for UE … complete!`).
